prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Pearland, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1393; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were involved in. Can you please state your full name for the record?

A: Yes, I'm [claimant name].

Q: Thank you. Where were you when the accident occurred?

A: I was driving through an intersection in Pearland, Texas. I was turning left onto the cross street.

Q: What was the traffic signal doing when you began your turn?

A: It was green for my direction. I waited for oncoming traffic to clear, and when the gap looked safe, I started to turn.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. I saw headlights coming, but I thought they were farther away than they were. By the time I realized how close they were, it was too late to stop.

Q: How fast would you estimate you were going when you started the turn?

A: Maybe ten or fifteen miles an hour. I was going slowly because I was turning.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Have you been seen by a medical provider since the collision?

A: Yes. I went to urgent care the same day. They said I have a back strain. My lower back is sore, and it hurts more when I bend or sit for a long time.

Q: Are you currently receiving any treatment?

A: I'm doing physical therapy twice a week and taking over-the-counter pain relievers. My doctor said to expect about six weeks of recovery.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I'm sorry the accident happened, and I'm glad no one was seriously hurt beyond what I've described.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
